ANTI_FLY.name: Anti-Fly
ANTI_FLY.description: An unmodified Wound roll of X+ against a target with the fly keyword scores a Critical Wound.

ANTI_INFANTRY.name: Anti-Infantry
ANTI_INFANTRY.description: An unmodified Wound roll of X+ against a target with the infantry keyword scores a Critical Wound.

ANTI_VEHICLE.name: Anti-Vehicle
ANTI_VEHICLE.description: An unmodified Wound roll of X+ against a target with the vehicle keyword scores a Critical Wound.

ANTI_PSYKER.name: Anti-Psyker
ANTI_PSYKER.description: An unmodified Wound roll of X+ against a target with the psyker keyword scores a Critical Wound.

ASSAULT.name: Assault
ASSAULT.description: Units containing one or more models with this weapon can shoot using assault shooting (they can shoot after Advancing).

BLAST.name: Blast
BLAST.description: Each time you gather attack dice for this weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down); a Blast X weapon adds X dice per five models.

CLEAVE.name: Cleave
CLEAVE.description: Each time you gather attack dice for this weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon's attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).

DEVASTATING_WOUNDS.name: Devastating Wounds
DEVASTATING_WOUNDS.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon results in a critical wound, the attack sequence ends and the target suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic, inflicted after any normal damage. Those mortal wounds can damage at most one model per critical wound.

EXTRA_ATTACKS.name: Extra Attacks
EXTRA_ATTACKS.description: The bearer can attack with this weapon in addition to any other weapons it can make attacks with.

HAZARDOUS.name: Hazardous
HAZARDOUS.description: Each time a unit is selected to shoot or to fight, after it has resolved all of its attacks, make one hazard roll (one D6) per Hazardous weapon selected: on a 1-2 that unit suffers 1 mortal wound, or 3 mortal wounds if every model in the unit is a Monster or Vehicle.

HEAVY.name: Heavy
HEAVY.description: Add 1 to the Hit roll in your Shooting phase if the attacking unit is unengaged, was not set up on the battlefield this turn, and no model in it moved more than 3" this turn.

IGNORES_COVER.name: Ignores Cover
IGNORES_COVER.description: The target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against an attack made with this weapon.

INDIRECT_FIRE.name: Indirect Fire
INDIRECT_FIRE.description: A line of sight on the target is not required to attack with this weapon.

LETHAL_HITS.name: Lethal Hits
LETHAL_HITS.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target (no wound roll is made, so it cannot be a critical wound).

MELTA.name: Melta
MELTA.description: Increase the Damage by X when targeting units within half range.

PISTOL.name: Pistol
PISTOL.description: The bearer can shoot with this weapon even if within Engagement Range of enemy units, but must target one of those enemy units. Cannot be shot alongside any other non-Pistol weapon (except by a Monster or Vehicle).

PRECISION.name: Precision
PRECISION.description: While resolving attacks made with this weapon, at the start of the Allocation Order step, if the target unit contains one or more CHARACTER models visible to one or more attacking models, the attacking player can make one such CHARACTER's allocation group the current allocation group.

PSYCHIC.name: Psychic
PSYCHIC.description: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's BS/WS characteristic and to the hit roll. Attacks made with this weapon are psychic attacks.

RAPID_FIRE.name: Rapid Fire
RAPID_FIRE.description: Increase this weapon's Attacks by X when target unit is within half range.

SUSTAINED_HITS.name: Sustained Hits
SUSTAINED_HITS.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon results in a critical hit, that attack scores X additional hits on the target.

TORRENT.name: Torrent
TORRENT.description: Each time an attack is made with such a weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

TWIN_LINKED.name: Twin Linked
TWIN_LINKED.description: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, you can re-roll the wound roll.
